_comment: Category playbook. apt_hunter uses keywords to build queries; apt_requirements uses 'questions' to build the brief; apt_convincer uses 'pain_points' and 'objections_likely' to prepare proof. 'conversion_weight' is learned over time by apt_self_trainer - start with these priors.

categories.name: Restaurant / Cafe / Dhaba
pain_points: Foodpanda/Zomato 25-30% commission letay hain
Menu PDF hai, phone pe nahi khulta
Online order ka koi direct rasta nahi
Reviews Google pe hain par website ka link nahi
categories.proof_angle: Direct WhatsApp order button se commission bach jata hai
questions: Menu kitni baar change hota hai?
Foodpanda se kitna commission jata hai?
Peak hours mein kitne orders aate hain?

categories.name: Clinic / Doctor / Dental
pain_points: Phone par appointment booking mein staff ka waqt zaya
Patients ko timings/fees maloom nahi hotin
No-show patients se nuksan
Google listing pe timings ghalat hain
categories.proof_angle: Online appointment form se phone calls 35% kam, no-shows bhi kam
questions: Appointment kaise book hoti hai abhi?
Kya aap online consultation dete hain?
Staff kitna waqt phone par lagata hai?

categories.name: Salon / Spa / Beauty Parlour
pain_points: Instagram pe kaam chal raha hai par booking manual hai
Price list online nahi - log phone kar ke poochte hain
Bridal packages ki details share karna mushkil
categories.proof_angle: WhatsApp booking se double-booking ka masla khatam
questions: Bridal package ka rate kya hai?

categories.name: Gym / Fitness Centre
pain_points: Membership inquiries phone par handle hoti hain
Timings aur fees update karna mushkil
New members ke liye koi online signup nahi
categories.proof_angle: Free trial signup form se walk-ins barh jate hain

categories.name: Real Estate / Property
pain_points: Property listings WhatsApp images mein bhejni part hain
Leads ziyada tar Facebook ads se aate hain, landing page nahi
Projects update karne mein haftay lag jate hain
categories.proof_angle: Landing page se ad cost per lead kam hota hai
questions: Kaunse projects promote kar rahe hain?
Ads pe kitna kharch karte hain mahine mein?
Listing kitni baar update hoti hai?

categories.name: School / Academy / Institute
pain_points: Admission forms offline hain
Parents ko result/timings maloom karne mein pareshani
Website purani hai, 2018 ki baat lagti hai
categories.proof_angle: Online admission form se admission office ka bojh kam

categories.name: Pharmacy / Medical Store
pain_points: Customers phone kar ke medicine poochte hain
Home delivery ka koi system nahi
categories.proof_angle: WhatsApp order se repeat customers barhte hain
questions: Kya aap WhatsApp orders lete hain?

categories.name: Boutique / Clothing / Fashion
pain_points: Catalogue sirf Instagram pe hai
Photos heavy hain, site slow hai
Out-of-stock items par bhi log poochte rehte hain
categories.proof_angle: Optimised catalogue se mobile pe load time 4s se 1.2s
questions: Instagram se kitne orders aate hain?

categories.name: Auto Workshop / Car Care
pain_points: Repeat customers ko yaad nahi rehta kab service karni thi
Log pehle phone kar ke rate poochte hain
categories.proof_angle: WhatsApp reminder se repeat booking barhti hai

categories.name: Hotel / Guest House
pain_points: Booking.com commission 15-18% hai
Direct booking ka koi rasta nahi
Rooms ki photos purani hain
categories.proof_angle: Direct booking engine se commission bachao - 1 saal mein site ka paisa nikal jata hai
questions: Booking.com se kitni booking aati hai?

categories.name: Law Firm / Legal Services
pain_points: Clients trust ke liye pehle website dekhte hain
Practice areas clearly mention nahi hain
categories.proof_angle: Professional profile se high-value clients ka trust barhta hai

categories.name: Electronics / Mobile Shop
pain_points: Price list roz change hoti hai
Customers WhatsApp par rate poochte rehte hain
categories.proof_angle: WhatsApp catalogue link se rate poochne walon ka waqt bachta hai
questions: Kya aap repair bhi karte hain?
Stock kitni baar update hota hai?
